scientific_integrity: A theorem for a specified positive two-atom compound-Poisson jump law, proved by an all-degree coefficient sign pattern and rigorous rational endpoint enclosures; no general result on arbitrary two-point jump laws is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the jump probabilities 39/40 at 1 and 1/40 at 5, any positive Poisson intensity, and the variance-exact right sub-gamma pole. Independent audit and comprehensive historical-priority certification are not performed.
title: Strict unimodality of the variance-exact sub-gamma scale for a two-jump Poisson law
